macro_findings: Eight direct-shape Qdrant parents and two .github upstream-maintenance skills have distinct SKILL.md blob and package-tree identities; no path matches an earlier terminal candidate decision.

Four Qdrant parent router package trees contain 15 nested first-class child SKILL.md paths previously terminally source-vetted; parent and child path-level decisions are distinct but their underlying content overlaps.

Nine unchanged-use rejects: production migration/upgrade/monitoring, private telemetry and external snippet search, cloud spend and destructive retention, unpinned gh-aw remote prompt loading, unapproved plugin builds.
One reference-only deployment decision tree offers useful trade-offs but is not permission to provision or install; root MIT does not license third-party services or binary assets.
The two .github packages are upstream contributor tooling and should not be misrepresented as generic user-facing skills.
No Qdrant release-note/API freshness, security scan, production behavioral validation or performance benchmark executed.
